newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia sees '97 tax revs of 12.3 trillion pesos.
newsitem.headline: Colombia sees '97 tax revs of 12.3 trillion pesos.

text.p: Colombia has set a target of raising 12.3 trillion pesos in tax revenues in 1997 compared to 10.1 trillion pesos last year, the president's office said in a statement Monday.
Of that total, 5.9 trillion pesos will come from income tax, 4.1 trillion from sales tax and 3.3 billion pesos from import tariffs.
The statement said the increase in revenues would be possible following tax reforms which modified tariff levels, broadened the tax base and cracked down on tax evasion.
